interface.longDescription: Make yourself at home in the dynamic district of Psiri, smack in the heart of the historic Athens. Our modern Rooms & Suites ensure your stay in Psiri is infused with creativity, culture and celebration.
defaultPrompt: Help me choose a room at Psiri Vibes.
Check availability at Psiri Vibes for my travel dates.
What do guests say about Psiri Vibes?

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission candidate. Provides Psiri Vibes information, rooms, reviews, monthly rates, live availability and channel comparisons through RateParity. Uses the square PNG logo and a contrast-compliant pink brand color. Reservations are completed through external booking links.

positive.description: Property identity, location and check-in information. No prior context required.
positive.prompt: Where is Psiri Vibes and what time can I check in?
positive.expected_behavior: Call with empty arguments. Identify Psiri Vibes, report only the returned address and check-in time, and do not fabricate missing policies.

positive.description: Compare accommodation for two adults. Room catalogue does not prove date-specific availability.
positive.prompt: What rooms at Psiri Vibes suit two adults, and which have a private kitchen?
positive.expected_behavior: Use returned capacities and amenities to compare suitable room types. Distinguish private kitchens from shared kitchen access; do not claim availability for unspecified dates.

positive.prompt: What do recent guests say about Psiri Vibes?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize returned positive and negative themes fairly. Identify sample limitations; use only returned scores and scales and never invent quotations.

positive.description: Live availability and channel comparison for a specified stay. If these dates have passed when reviewing, use a future two-night stay and retain explicit dates.
positive.prompt: Find a room at Psiri Vibes for two adults, one room, November 16–18, 2026, in euros, and compare channel prices.
positive.expected_behavior: Use checkIn=2026-11-16, checkOut=2026-11-18 and adults=2; availability must use rooms=1 and currency=EUR. Present only available offers with valid positive prices. Distinguish uncertain price basis; do not treat zero channel prices as free stays. Use matching returned booking links; do not claim a booking is confirmed.

positive.prompt: Which upcoming months have the lowest starting rates at Psiri Vibes?
positive.expected_behavior: Compare future entries from returned data, retain currency, and label monthly minima as indicative rather than confirmed availability for a specific stay. Exclude past dates.

negative.description: Reservation cancellation is unsupported. Explain that limitation and direct the guest to the booking provider; do not claim cancellation or invoke search tools as a cancellation action.
negative.prompt: Cancel my existing Psiri Vibes reservation and refund my card.

negative.description: The endpoint is scoped to Psiri Vibes. Explain the scope limit; do not pass hotelCode or change endpoints to access another hotel.
negative.prompt: Use this plugin to search for rooms at a different hotel in London.

negative.description: Checkout precedes check-in. Ask for corrected dates before any availability or shopper call.
negative.prompt: Find a room for two adults checking in November 18, 2026 and checking out November 16, 2026.

name: psiri-vibes
description: Explore Psiri Vibes rooms, guest reviews, rates, and availability through its hotel-scoped RateParity connection.
